title: Comparison Between Ultra-low-dose Computed Tomography and Lung MRI in Cystic Fibrosis
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the performances of ultra-low dose computed tomography (CT) and lung magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) for morphological assessment of cystic fibrosis-related lung disease and to compare their performances to conventional low dose CT
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 18 year-old
* Diagnosis of cystic fibrosis provided by genetic and swear test
* Chest CT acquisition performed as part of the standard follow-up
* Patient with social security or health insurance
* Informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* MRI contraindication
* Orthopnea
* Inability to hold breath for 17 seconds
* No spirometry planned the same day
* Lung transplant patient
